news.title: Vibe coding platform Base44 launches own model as AI startups seek defensibility
news.description: Wix-owned vibe coding platform Base44 has started rolling out its own AI model — with hopes that it will eventually outperform frontier models.

news.title: Gemini’s personalized AI image generation is now free for US users
news.description: Google is expanding Gemini’s personalized AI image generation to eligible free users in the U.S., allowing the chatbot to create images based on your interests and data from connected Google apps.

news.title: Anthropic and Gov. Newsom forge deal allowing California government to use Claude at half price
news.description: As Anthropic forges a closer relationship with the state of California, the federal government has made an enemy out of the OpenAI rival.

news.title: Arena, the AI leaderboard everyone uses, is now a $100M business
news.description: The startup, which runs a popular free AI leaderboard, launched its commercial service just last September.

news.title: Ford rehires human engineers after AI fails to match quality checks
news.description: The car-maker found AI quality checks failed to match the skill of veteran technicians.

news.title: Tech firms are blaming AI for mega device and console price rises
news.description: Xbox consoles, Nintendo's new Switch 2 and Valve's Steam Deck are just some of the gadgets seeing price hikes in recent months.

news.title: OpenAI Has New AI Models. Here’s Why You Can’t Use Them
news.description: The White House asked OpenAI to delay the rollout of its GPT-5.6 AI models, two weeks after Anthropic had to take its most advanced AI models offline.

news.title: Europe Is Fed Up and Wants Its Own AI
news.description: It's a stretch to think that the continent can build a top-tier model, but it has an advantage: Donald Trump.
